judgement.reason: CommaFeed supports PostgreSQL, and the Dockerfile that needs CI-built artifacts can be replaced with a contained build change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /commafeed/data (commafeed-server/src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not include a setting that moves the data in /commafeed/data (the default H2 embedded database) to PostgreSQL, so the volume may hold durable state.
